domain_description: Comprehensive legal analysis across 18 practice areas including contract law, litigation, regulatory compliance, intellectual property, employment, real estate, criminal defense, family law, immigration, bankruptcy, environmental, securities, antitrust, tax litigation, international law, and healthcare law. Engines provide doctrine-level reasoning grounded in federal and state statutes, case law precedent, and professional standards.
authority_sources: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct
State Civil Practice and Remedies Codes

engines.name: Contract Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze commercial and consumer contracts for enforceability, risk allocation, ambiguity, boilerplate effectiveness, breach exposure, and remedies under UCC and common law. Identifies problematic clauses, unconscionability risks, and drafting deficiencies.
doctrine_topics: statute of frauds and writing requirements
material breach vs minor breach distinction
choice of law and forum selection enforceability

golden_queries.question: Analyze a service agreement that contains a unilateral modification clause, a one-year non-compete, and a limitation of liability capped at fees paid in the prior 12 months. Identify enforceability risks.
required_elements: unilateral modification enforceability under consideration doctrine
limitation of liability validity under UCC and common law
failure_signals: no reference to consideration for modifications
generic contract advice without clause-specific analysis

golden_queries.question: Does a verbal agreement to sell 500 custom-manufactured widgets for $8,000 fall under the statute of frauds?

engines.name: Case Law Research Engine
engines.function: Research and analyze judicial opinions, identify controlling precedent, distinguish holdings from dicta, trace doctrinal evolution across circuits, and assess precedential weight for litigation strategy.
doctrine_topics: case law synthesis and rule extraction
en banc and Supreme Court certiorari analysis

golden_queries.question: Trace the evolution of the qualified immunity doctrine from Harlow v. Fitzgerald (1982) through recent circuit applications. Identify the current circuit split.
required_elements: Harlow v. Fitzgerald clearly established law standard
sequencing of constitutional violation and qualified immunity analysis

engines.name: Regulatory Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze regulatory frameworks, assess compliance obligations, identify regulatory risk exposure, and develop compliance program architectures across federal and state regulatory schemes.
doctrine_topics: whistleblower protections and qui tam actions
regulatory change monitoring and impact assessment

golden_queries.question: A mid-size company discovers it has been inadvertently violating an EPA discharge reporting requirement for 18 months. Analyze the voluntary self-disclosure options and potential penalty exposure.
required_elements: statute of limitations for environmental violations
failure_signals: failure to distinguish civil from criminal exposure

engines.name: Legal Document Draft Engine
engines.function: Draft and analyze legal documents including pleadings, motions, briefs, contracts, corporate resolutions, and settlement agreements with proper legal formatting, citation standards, and jurisdiction-specific requirements.
doctrine_topics: pleading standards under Twombly and Iqbal
appellate brief structure and standards of review

golden_queries.question: Draft a motion to dismiss under FRCP 12(b)(6) for a breach of contract claim where the plaintiff failed to allege performance of conditions precedent. Include the standard of review.
required_elements: prayer for relief with alternative requests
failure_signals: no case law support for arguments

engines.name: Litigation Risk Engine
engines.function: Assess litigation exposure, evaluate claim viability, estimate damages ranges, analyze settlement postures, and provide risk-adjusted litigation strategy recommendations including cost-benefit analysis.
doctrine_topics: statute of limitations and repose analysis

golden_queries.question: Assess the litigation risk for a company facing a products liability claim where a consumer was injured by a defective component supplied by a third-party manufacturer. The company assembled the final product. Statute of limitations is 2 years; injury occurred 20 months ago.
failure_signals: no distinction between strict liability theories

engines.name: IP Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze intellectual property issues including patent validity, trademark likelihood of confusion, copyright fair use, trade secret misappropriation, and IP portfolio strategy under federal IP statutes.
doctrine_topics: patent claim construction and validity (35 USC)
trademark likelihood of confusion factors (Lanham Act)
copyright fair use four-factor test (17 USC 107)
trade secret misappropriation under DTSA and UTSA
prior art search and invalidity contentions

golden_queries.question: A software company discovers a competitor is using a nearly identical logo and brand name in the same market. Analyze the trademark infringement claim under the Lanham Act using the likelihood of confusion test.
failure_signals: no specific likelihood of confusion factors
no reference to Lanham Act 15 USC 1125

engines.name: Employment Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze employment law issues including discrimination claims, wage and hour compliance, FMLA administration, workplace safety, employee classification, and non-compete enforceability under federal and state labor laws.
doctrine_topics: Title VII discrimination and disparate impact analysis
FLSA wage and hour classification (exempt vs non-exempt)
ADA reasonable accommodation and undue hardship
workplace harassment and hostile work environment

golden_queries.question: An employer classifies all its field service technicians as independent contractors. They work 40+ hours per week, use company vehicles, follow company scheduling, but provide their own tools. Analyze the misclassification risk under the FLSA economic reality test and the IRS 20-factor test.

engines.name: Real Estate Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze real property transactions, title issues, zoning compliance, landlord-tenant disputes, easements, liens, and closing procedures under state property law and federal fair housing requirements.
doctrine_topics: real estate contract contingencies and remedies

golden_queries.question: A buyer discovers an unrecorded easement across the property after closing. The title company issued a standard owner's policy. Analyze the buyer's remedies against the seller, the title company, and options regarding the easement holder.
required_elements: title insurance coverage for unrecorded easements
failure_signals: failure to distinguish recorded vs unrecorded interests
no discussion of warranty deed covenants

engines.name: Criminal Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze criminal law issues including elements of offenses, constitutional protections, sentencing guidelines, defense strategies, and post-conviction remedies under federal and state criminal codes.
doctrine_topics: elements of crimes and mens rea requirements
Fourth Amendment search and seizure analysis
Sixth Amendment right to counsel and confrontation
double jeopardy and lesser included offenses

golden_queries.question: Police conducted a traffic stop and, after detecting an odor of marijuana in a state where marijuana is legal, searched the vehicle without consent or a warrant. Analyze the constitutionality of the search under the Fourth Amendment automobile exception.
required_elements: odor of marijuana in legal state
state law vs federal law conflict impact on probable cause
failure_signals: failure to address legalization impact on probable cause

engines.name: Family Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze family law matters including divorce proceedings, child custody determinations, child support calculations, property division, adoption, and prenuptial agreement enforceability under state domestic relations law.
doctrine_topics: best interest of the child standard
adoption procedures and termination of rights

golden_queries.question: In a contested divorce in Texas, the wife seeks to set aside a prenuptial agreement signed 3 days before the wedding, claiming she did not have time to consult an attorney and the husband did not disclose a significant real estate portfolio. Analyze enforceability.

engines.name: Immigration Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze immigration law issues including visa classification, adjustment of status, removal proceedings, asylum claims, employment-based immigration, and nationality law under the INA and related regulations.
doctrine_topics: visa classification and eligibility (H-1B, L-1, O-1, EB categories)
adjustment of status requirements under INA 245
removal proceedings and cancellation of removal
asylum eligibility and credible fear analysis
employment-based green card processing (PERM, I-140, I-485)
consular processing and visa refusal grounds

golden_queries.question: An H-1B visa holder with an approved I-140 is laid off. Analyze the 60-day grace period options, portability under AC21, and the impact on pending adjustment of status if one has been filed for more than 180 days.

engines.name: Bankruptcy Engine
engines.function: Analyze bankruptcy proceedings under Chapters 7, 11, and 13 including eligibility, means testing, plan confirmation, preference actions, automatic stay, and discharge scope under 11 USC.
doctrine_topics: Chapter 7 eligibility and means test (11 USC 707(b))
Chapter 13 disposable income and plan feasibility
automatic stay scope and relief from stay motions
proof of claim filing and objections

golden_queries.question: A debtor made a $75,000 payment to a longtime vendor 85 days before filing Chapter 11. The vendor argues it was a contemporaneous exchange for new value. Analyze the preference avoidance action and available defenses.

engines.name: Environmental Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze environmental law issues including CERCLA liability, Clean Air Act compliance, Clean Water Act permitting, NEPA review, hazardous waste management under RCRA, and state environmental regulatory programs.
doctrine_topics: CERCLA strict joint and several liability
Clean Air Act permitting (Title V, NSR, PSD)
Clean Water Act NPDES permitting (33 USC 1342)
Brownfield redevelopment and innocent landowner defense
citizen suit provisions under environmental statutes
environmental due diligence and Phase I/II ESA

golden_queries.question: A company purchases a former gas station property and later discovers underground storage tank contamination. Analyze potential CERCLA liability as a current owner and the innocent landowner defense under CERCLA 107(r) and 101(40).
required_elements: Phase I ESA ASTM E1527 standard
failure_signals: no mention of all appropriate inquiries

engines.name: Securities Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze securities regulation including registration requirements, exemptions, insider trading, proxy rules, SEC enforcement, and corporate disclosure obligations under the Securities Act of 1933 and Exchange Act of 1934.
doctrine_topics: securities registration under Securities Act Section 5
insider trading under Section 10(b) and Rule 10b-5
Howey test for investment contract analysis
blue sky laws and state securities registration

golden_queries.question: A startup wants to raise $5 million from 50 accredited investors and 10 non-accredited investors without SEC registration. Analyze the available exemptions under Regulation D and the implications of including non-accredited investors.
failure_signals: failure to address non-accredited investor disclosure requirements

engines.name: Antitrust Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze antitrust and competition law issues including horizontal agreements, vertical restraints, merger review, monopolization, and price discrimination under the Sherman Act, Clayton Act, and FTC Act.
doctrine_topics: Sherman Act Section 1 per se vs rule of reason analysis
horizontal price fixing and market allocation
vertical restraints and resale price maintenance
Clayton Act Section 7 merger analysis and HHI
group boycotts and refusals to deal

golden_queries.question: Two competing oil service companies in the Permian Basin are considering a merger that would give the combined entity 45% market share in pressure pumping services. Analyze the antitrust review process and likely agency response.
failure_signals: no reference to DOJ/FTC merger guidelines

engines.name: Tax Litigation Engine
engines.function: Analyze tax controversy and litigation including IRS examination, administrative appeals, Tax Court proceedings, refund litigation, penalty abatement, and collection due process under IRC and Treasury Regulations.
doctrine_topics: IRS examination process and audit selection
administrative appeals procedures and protest letters
Tax Court petition and trial procedures
refund litigation in district court and Court of Federal Claims
penalty abatement and reasonable cause defense
statute of limitations on assessment and collection
IRS summons enforcement and privilege issues

golden_queries.question: An individual receives a notice of deficiency (90-day letter) for $250,000 in additional tax. The assessment is based on unreported income from an offshore account. Analyze the procedural options and penalty exposure including FBAR penalties.
required_elements: burden of proof in Tax Court
failure_signals: no timeline for Tax Court petition
failure to distinguish willful vs non-willful FBAR penalties

engines.name: International Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze international legal issues including treaty interpretation, cross-border transactions, international arbitration, foreign sovereign immunity, sanctions compliance, and anti-corruption laws (FCPA/UK Bribery Act).
doctrine_topics: Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) anti-bribery provisions
international trade law and WTO disputes
bilateral investment treaties and investor-state arbitration

golden_queries.question: A US oil company's foreign subsidiary paid $50,000 to a government official in Country X to expedite a drilling permit. Analyze whether this violates the FCPA, considering the facilitating payments exception and the jurisdictional reach of the statute.
failure_signals: failure to analyze facilitating payment exception

engines.name: Healthcare Law Engine
engines.function: Analyze healthcare regulatory issues including HIPAA privacy and security, Stark Law physician self-referral, Anti-Kickback Statute, Medicare/Medicaid compliance, FDA regulation, and healthcare transaction structuring.
doctrine_topics: HIPAA Privacy Rule and minimum necessary standard
HIPAA Security Rule administrative and technical safeguards
Stark Law physician self-referral prohibitions (42 USC 1395nn)
Anti-Kickback Statute and safe harbors (42 USC 1320a-7b)
False Claims Act and healthcare fraud (31 USC 3729)
FDA drug and device approval pathways
healthcare entity mergers and CON requirements

golden_queries.question: A hospital system wants to offer free office space and billing services to a physician group in exchange for referrals. Analyze the arrangement under the Stark Law and Anti-Kickback Statute, identifying applicable exceptions and safe harbors.
required_elements: office space rental safe harbor requirements
failure_signals: no distinction between Stark and AKS
failure to identify specific safe harbors
